command:
set -eu
date --iso-8601=seconds
systemctl is-enabled bussassistent cloudflared bussassistent-backup.timer
if test -f /run/reboot-required; then cat /run/reboot-required; cat /run/reboot-required.pkgs; fi
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
print(json.dumps({str(p):p.read_text().strip()for p in Path('/sys/class/power_supply').glob('*/online')}))
PY
ls -l /boot/vmlinuz-* /boot/initrd.img-*
grep -E '^GRUB_(TIMEOUT|TIMEOUT_STYLE|DEFAULT)=' /etc/default/grub
